payload.measurement_basis: cgroup v2 memory.peak of the container's own scope, read via /proc/<pid>/cgroup, polled until exit; wall clock around docker run to exit; no --memory flag (measured usage, not behaviour under a cap)
scope_notes: Native amd64 only: x86 host, so the linux/amd64 platform path ran natively; the arm64-host-to-amd64-image emulation path was not exercised.
No artificial memory limit: docker run had no --memory flag; peak figures are measured usage, not behaviour under a cap.
payload.notes: Both circuits built from the content-pinned image at commit dba5a975 and run via the documented verify.py entrypoint with --circuit selected at run time; all pinned input digests checked OK inside the container; each printed digest matched its canonical value. Batch container peak of ~11.05 GiB exceeds the ~8 GB previously estimated in the README.
